player_prompt.intro:
Ngeye Mwana {player_id} mu kipindi cha {num_rounds} cha mchezo wa Mawe-Papelo-Kisu.
Kulengwa kwenu ni kushinda vipindi vingi iwezekanavyo.
Mu kila kipindi, itikieni na moja ya haya: '[rock]', '[paper]', au '[scissors]'.
Naweza pia kutumia '[r]', '[p]', au '[s]' kama njia fupi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lisolo lya kutambula teleyi. Ita [rock], [paper], or [scissors].

game_action.selects: Muena manaya {player_id} udi usungula tshikoso tshia {move}.

message.round_draw: Tshikondo tshia ndekelu: Dienza dia nsongo
message.round_win: Tshikondo tshijima: Muena manaya {winner} udi utshimuna!

outcome.p0_wins: Muena manaya 0 ke uvua mutshimune mu nseke ya bungi!
outcome.p1_wins: Muntu wa libala 1 alushinda mikondo mingi!
